name: Cora Citation Network Dataset
description: The Cora dataset is a seminal benchmark for node classification and graph representation learning. It consists of 2,708 machine learning scientific papers categorized into seven subfields (Case_Based, Genetic_Algorithms, Neural_Networks, Probabilistic_Methods, Reinforcement_Learning, Rule_Learning, Theory), connected by 5,429 citation links and characterized by 1,433 binary word features.
